mapper.sql: l.id, l.user_id, l.academic_year, l.origin_province, l.origin_city, l.origin_county, l.bank_name, l.contract_no, l.receipt_no, l.amount, l.disbursed, l.disbursed_at, l.status, l.return_reason, l.submitted_at, l.counselor_id, l.counselor_at, l.reviewer_id, l.reviewed_at, l.remark, l.evidence_url, l.created_at, l.updated_at, l.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, sp.student_no AS student_no, sp.class_name AS class_name, cm.real_name AS counselor_name
FROM student_loan l LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = l.user_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users cm ON cm.id = sp.counselor_id

sql.if: AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sp.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.contract_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.bank_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_loan (user_id, academic_year, origin_province, origin_city, origin_county, bank_name, contract_no, receipt_no, amount, disbursed, disbursed_at, status, submitted_at, remark, evidence_url, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{academicYear}, #{originProvince}, #{originCity}, #{originCounty}, #{bankName}, #{contractNo}, #{receiptNo}, #{amount}, #{disbursed}, #{disbursedAt}, #{status}, NOW(), #{remark}, #{evidenceUrl}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT academic_year FROM student_loan WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY academic_year DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE student_loan SET academic_year = #{academicYear}, origin_province = #{originProvince}, origin_city = #{originCity}, origin_county = #{originCounty}, bank_name = #{bankName}, contract_no = #{contractNo}, receipt_no = #{receiptNo}, amount = #{amount}, disbursed = #{disbursed}, disbursed_at = #{disbursedAt}, remark = #{remark}, evidence_url = #{evidenceUrl}, status = 'submitted', return_reason = NULL, submitted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('submitted', 'returned')

UPDATE student_loan SET status = #{toStatus}, return_reason = #{reason}, counselor_id = #{counselorId}, counselor_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE student_loan SET status = 'confirmed', reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'counselor_approved'

UPDATE student_loan SET disbursed = #{disbursed}, disbursed_at = #{disbursedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('submitted', 'returned', 'counselor_approved', 'confirmed')
